findings.text: Panic when obj1 is time.Time but obj2 is a different struct type: CanConvert is only checked for obj1 (line 30), so obj2Value.Convert(timeType) on line 42 will panic if obj2 is a non-time struct. Example: compare(time.Now(), someOtherStruct{}) causes runtime panic.

0.reason: The code only checks CanConvert on obj1Value, so if obj1 is a time.Time but obj2 is a different struct type, obj2Value.Convert(timeType) will panic, which is a genuine defect distinct from the UnixNano overflow issue.
